interface.title: ChemoSuite: NOM & Slime-Lignin Analysis (v3.0.0 Pro, Streamlit)
interface.field: Environmental analytical chemistry / chemometrics of natural organic matter in water
interface.stage_of_work: Data processing, descriptor extraction, multiblock classification and reporting after the instrument measurements are done
interface.what_it_is_for: Process spectra from several instruments (FT-ICR MS, EEM fluorescence, UV-Vis, FTIR, NMR, thermal, SEC, elemental), extract chemical descriptors from each, then fuse them and run PLS-DA to tell natural Lake Baikal organic matter apart from pulp-mill sludge-lignin contamination.

data.note: I uploaded the paired FT-ICR, EEM and UV-Vis files (Baikal_Control_01_* and Lignin_Impact_01_*). FTIR used the built-in 'Reference Benchmark (12 samples)'. EEM-PARAFAC was also tried on the built-in 'Synthetic Benchmark (Baikal/Lignin)'. The ML module used 'Folder Batch Screening' on the server's demo_data folder: 100 files, 83 parsed, 47 samples assembled, 8 modalities.

tree.general: Decide whether water samples carry natural organic matter or industrial contamination, using evidence from several measurement types
tree.specific: Tell Lake Baikal natural NOM apart from BPPM sludge-lignin using FT-ICR MS, EEM, UV-Vis, FTIR and the other modalities, fused in PLS-DA

read assignment rate and error, scan the formula table
